correctness.rationale: Positive invariant rectangles exist by choosing tau/d2<r<d1/sigma, so solutions are bounded and positive. Logistic comparison with a2 positive mean bounds resident y below away from zero. For p=sigma/d2, G'=a1+p*a2 with zero mean, exact W=x*y^p*exp(-G) satisfies W'/W=-kx and (1/W)'=k exp(G)*y^-p>c>0; hence W and x are O(1/t). Log ratio h=log(y/Y) satisfies scalar forced stable equation h'=tau*x-d2*Y(e^h-1), so h=O(1/t). Integration of the exact inverse W law against periodic Q yields W=(kI*t)^-1+O(log t/t²), x=f(t)/t+same error; subtract unique positive periodic solution H(t)/t in h equation to obtain h=H/t+O(log t/t²) and y=Y+YH/t+same error. Mean(f)=1/k by normalization, rigorously proving seasonal invariance. Independent rational check for source coefficients (d1,d2,sigma,tau)=(2,3,4/5,11/10) gives k=128/75; finite RK4 output not a proof.
